---
name: requirements-analysis
description: Analyze user stories and create functional and non-functional requirements.
---

# Requirements Analysis Skill

1. Read the complete user story.
2. Identify business objectives.
3. Identify functional requirements.
4. Identify non-functional requirements.
5. Identify missing information.
6. Ask clarification questions.
7. Document acceptance criteria.
8. Prepare requirements.md.
9. Wait for human approval.
